coffee-pub-scribe.headingH1Scribe-Hint: Scribe is a versatile tool that turns narrative descriptions into visually appealing cards, perfect for enhancing storytelling in any campaign. With customizable styles and an easy handout feature, players can easily immerse themselves in the world and stay engaged with important details. Elevate your game with Scribe and bring your story to life.
coffee-pub-scribe.headingH2Theme-Hint: You can send narrative cards from the journal to the chat window. Choose the card that best aligns with your narrative.
coffee-pub-scribe.cardTheme-Hint: The Blacksmith card theme used for Scribe's chat cards. Leave on Blacksmith Default to follow the world setting.
coffee-pub-scribe.toolbarEnabled-Hint: Show the Scribe toolbar in narration blocks in the journal. Default: Enabled.
coffee-pub-scribe.headingH2Toolbar-Hint: Scribe will add a toolbar to its stylized block quotes. Identify the buttons you want on the toolbar. Default: Enabled.
coffee-pub-scribe.toolbarButtonNarration-Hint: Show the narration button in the toolbar. (Requires the toolbar is enabled) Default: Enabled.
coffee-pub-scribe.toolbarButtonIllustration-Hint: Show the illustration button in the toolbar. (Requires the toolbar is enabled) Default: Enabled.
coffee-pub-scribe.toolbarButtonHandout-Hint: Show the handout button in the toolbar. (Requires the toolbar is enabled) Default: Enabled.
coffee-pub-scribe.toolbarButtonCopy-Hint: Show the copy button in the toolbar. (Requires the toolbar is enabled) Default: Enabled.
coffee-pub-scribe.toolbarButtonExport-Hint: Show the save button in the toolbar. (Requires the toolbar is enabled) Default: Enabled.
coffee-pub-scribe.toolbarButtonPrint-Hint: Show the print button in the journal titlebar. (GM only) Default: Enabled.
coffee-pub-scribe.headingH2Handouts-Hint: Copy narrative cards from the journal to a folder that the party can view later.
coffee-pub-scribe.handoutFolder-Hint: The name of the folder in which you want to stare any handouts you share with the party. Default: Party Handouts
coffee-pub-scribe.folderColor-Hint: The hex value for the folder color. Default: #77274e
